# The Ashen War

The Ashen War ended in an Ember victory in 463, but the kingdom ceded the eastern marches in the peace settlement. Surviving chronicles disagree about what began the war: the Ashford Annals blame a border raid, while the Lantern Chronicle describes a succession dispute.
